props.gloss_en: one who says 'iron is incumbent on me' -- Acherim: he may not give less than a cubit by a cubit
what is it fit for? Rav Yosef: for a kalya orev (raven-repeller)
and some say: Acherim: he may not give less than a kalya orev
and how much [is that]? Rav Yosef: a cubit by a cubit
copper -- he may not give less than [the worth of] a silver ma'ah
R' Eliezer: he may not give less than a small copper hook
what is it fit for? Abaye: they scrape out the wicks with it and wipe the lamps

supports.gloss_en: למאי חזיא? -- לכלייא עורב: a cubit-square of iron serves as a raven-repeller (version 1)
וכמה? -- אמה על אמה: Rav Yosef gives the raven-repeller's size (version 2)
למאי חזיא? -- שמחטטין בה את הפתילות ומקנחין הנרות: a small copper hook serves the lamps
